scope: Actual Three renderer on an isolated local browser fixture. A/B/C use the same camera, lights, exposure and fixed PMREM environment. Not a native performance, provider, device-audio or physical-display test.
instrumentation: Only network routes serve owned candidate GLBs and an isolated HTML fixture. The public createBuddyRenderer/diagnostics/update/dispose interface is used unchanged. Still captures park the authored Idle opening pose with motion:false. Pointer motion uses real Playwright mouse events; the blur-handler check dispatches an explicitly simulated window blur/focus event.

visualReview.observations: Reviewed actual44/96/160/320 captures, synthetic light/dark/pattern backgrounds,320/96 turn/settle poses and eight-second video samples. Readable navy eyes, cyan appendages and broad lavender/peach undertones; fixed highlights respond to body orientation; no observed framing clip. Silent fixture recording25fps is not native render/OS presentation performance evidence.
